body:
## M-Press contributor workflow audited and corrected locally

Commit `18a9809b30ddd0303b1da22f4db12fc589e14ba6` is now on local `releases/v3.0.0`, fast-forwarded from `codex/mpress-contributor-guide`. Nothing pushed or published.

The public contributor page was still pinned to M-Press 1.0.17 and master, while the release setup uses 1.0.19 and releases/v3.0.0. It also lacked practical binary installation/PATH steps and a clear end-to-end authoring workflow.

The expanded `docs/mpress/content/contributing/documentation.md` now covers:

- All six official macOS/Linux/Windows AMD64/ARM64 archives, checksum verification, extraction, PATH setup and version verification.
- Go installation with the verified M-Press 1.0.19 minimum of Go 1.26.6, plus automatic toolchain selection.
- The existing page-edit wizard, manual fork/clone from the release branch, the live-preview URL and saved-file refresh, Markdown/components, new pages/navigation, translation checks and release-branch PR submission.
- Documentation-only prerequisites, separating the standalone executable workflow from Wails application builds and optional translation providers.

Added a visible `Contribute docs` header link in both configurations and a direct top-level sidebar link accessible on mobile. Fixed spacing between header links. Repository README/CONTRIBUTING, docs README and contributor setup pages link to the detailed walkthrough instead of repeating obsolete setup blocks. Twenty-seven existing locale pages received only mechanical version/branch corrections; the expanded English prose awaits translation sync.

Validation:

- Downloaded official Linux AMD64 archive, verified SHA-256, extracted/installed and ran `mpress version` with Go and Node.js absent from PATH. Verified Windows AMD64 archive checksum and mpress.exe layout. Native macOS/Windows execution was not performed.
- Ran the downloaded release executable's development server and verified a saved Markdown change appeared, then restored the source and confirmed refresh.
- Inspected desktop and mobile browser screenshots; the mobile menu exposes the direct guide link and document width equals the 390px viewport.
- Final strict M-Press build passed: 2,031 content pages / 2,192 files. Links/assets pass. All 19 existing documentation helper tests pass.
- Coverage and rendered-site errors match the prior baseline exactly: the nine missing release-policy translations (F24) remain unresolved. Translation audit has 1,000 non-blocking warnings after the English rewrite; no exception or gate was weakened.
- Required `coderabbit --plain` was attempted (unsupported by installed CLI); supported final CodeRabbit review completed with no findings across all 39 changed files. Diff checks pass.

This contribution-guidance follow-up is complete locally; #6337 remains open for the other audit findings, missing release-policy translations, translation sync, and publication.

Documentation corrections are committed on the existing `release-prep/v3.0.0` branch in a9866c121.

The pass corrects 43 English source pages covering the security examples, binding/time/event contracts, server/window behaviour, build/signing commands, CLI variables, onboarding templates, transports and testing. It synchronises the corresponding documentation and overview translations and all nine translated navigation trees with the current English source. The newer English release policy and release-post wording are unchanged. Nine release-post translations and their sidecars are prepared under `docs/mpress/drafts/`, with publication instructions; the post remains unpublished.

Credits now use the v3 site's own sponsor/contributor assets, maintained by the image-generation workflow. M-Press [v1.0.23](https://github.com/leaanthony/mpress/releases/tag/v1.0.23) fixes SVG object sizing and bold inline code beside CJK text. [v1.0.24](https://github.com/leaanthony/mpress/releases/tag/v1.0.24) fixes protected-only source updates being skipped during translation. Both releases are published; v1.0.24 passed conformance and Linux/macOS/Windows release smoke tests.

Validation with the checksum-verified published v1.0.24 binary:

- Strict translation coverage/audit: no errors or warnings in all nine locales. Reviewed technical-name/linguistic exceptions remain bound to exact source and target hashes; structural findings cannot be waived.
- 477 scoped page/locale audits and all nine unpublished article translations pass.
- Strict production build: 2,040 pages; draft preview: 2,050 pages.
- Local links/assets and site checks pass, with 204 pages per language.
- All 19 documentation helper tests pass.
- Real browser checks at 390px and 1440px pass, including contributor-image proportions and horizontal overflow.
- Generated app, frontend/bindings build, backend greeting/browser toast, security examples and runtime contract probes were exercised during the correction pass. Current signing/entitlements CLI help and the starter's actual Playwright selectors were checked again after recovery from the host crash.
- CodeRabbit was run before committing. Its suggested greeting locator was rejected because the actual starter explicitly sets `aria-label="greet-btn"`; this is now explained in the example and checked in a browser.

Keep this issue open for the underlying F30 framework starter mismatch: the default TypeScript starter still points its HTML entry at `main.js` while generating `main.ts`. The documentation examples now explicitly select the matching JavaScript template. Native macOS/Windows UI, platform package installs, signing and mobile hardware were not executed on this Linux host. No Wails release, live-site deployment or announcement was performed by this correction pass.
